description: This grouped bar chart illustrates two distinct metrics across four methods, presented with a tilted, three-dimensional perspective. The horizontal axis displays the categories arranged into two separate groups, though explicit group labels are not visible. The chart utilizes dual vertical value axes. The left vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 75 to 95 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The right vertical axis has a partially obscured label and a linear scale ranging from 100 to 600, with tick marks at intervals of 100. Faint dashed grid lines extend horizontally across the background. A legend at the bottom identifies the four methods, which correspond to the four bars within each group: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). All bars feature thin black outlines and are visually emphasized with their exact numerical values annotated directly above them. In the left group, which corresponds to the Accuracy axis, the values are not strictly sorted; the red CoT bar is the tallest at 91.19, followed by the light blue CCoT bar at 88.50, the green CoUT bar at 88.40, and the orange CoD bar is the shortest at 80.89. In the right group, corresponding to the right axis, the bars are arranged in descending order of their annotated values: the red CoT bar is the tallest at 676.85, followed by the orange CoD bar at 534.24, the light blue CCoT bar at 445.91, and the green CoUT bar is the shortest at 354.46.
